Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You open your arms. Bright doorways unfold beneath your summoned host, and the whole line steps into a new formation.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Every visible summon of yours within 6 squares.
Type
Magic / Movement

Teleport each of your visible summons within 6 squares up to 4 squares to a visible free supported space within 6 squares of you. Each destination fits the form's footprint. You choose the order; the destinations are separate. Each form retains its HP, conditions, remaining duration and command history.
